subject: civics
question_text: What is the work of the police?
answer_text: Work of the police includes: (i) Maintenance of law and order. (ii) Investigation of a case or taking FIR. (iii) Protection of the public and their property. (iv) Maintenance of the public safety. (v) Testifying truthfully in the court.
final_answer: The work of the police encompasses various responsibilities aimed at maintaining public safety and order.

subject: civics
question_text: List two things that the work of a Patwari includes.
answer_text: Two things that the work of a Patwari includes: (i) Main work is measuring of land and keeping land records. (ii) Collection of land revenue from farmers.
final_answer: The Patwari's work primarily involves land measurement and revenue collection.

subject: civics
question_text: What is the work of a tehsildar?
answer_text: Work of the tehsildar includes: (i) Hearing disputes related to lands. (ii) Supervising the work of the Patwaris. (iii) Ensuring that land records are properly kept. (iv) Ensuring proper collection of land revenue. (v) Making sure that the farmers can easily obtain a copy of their record. (vi) Issuing caste certificates for the students.
final_answer: The tehsildar's responsibilities encompass land dispute resolution and supervision of land records.

subject: civics
question_text: What issue is the poem trying to raise? Do you think this is an important issue? Why?
answer_text: The poem is trying to raise the issue of gender discrimination based on the inheritance of land by daughters. Yes, this is an important issue because: (i) Daughters are denied of the share. (ii) Sons do not look after their mother and sisters after getting a share of the property. (iii) Raising this issue will ensure the security of women.
final_answer: Addressing gender discrimination in land inheritance is crucial for women's security.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of social issues and their implications.

subject: civics
question_text: In what ways are the work of the Panchayat, that you read about in the previous chapter, and the work of the Patwari related to each other?
answer_text: The work of the Panchayat and the Patwari are related in the following ways: (i) Panchayat often settles small disputes of lands between locals, while Patwari maintains the land records and settles disputes. (ii) Panchayat levies local taxes and revenue, while Patwari organizes the collected revenues. (iii) Both Patwari and Panchayat need to cooperate with each other on construction works over land area.
final_answer: The Panchayat and Patwari collaborate on land disputes, tax collection, and construction projects.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of the roles of local governance.

subject: civics
question_text: Visit a police station and find out the work that the police have to do to prevent crime and maintain law and order in their area especially during festivals, public meetings etc.
answer_text: The work done by the police to prevent crime and maintain law and order in their area especially during festivals and public meetings includes: (i) They enquire about the amount of crowd to be gathered in their local areas. (ii) According to the crowd, they prepare for proper management and policemen set up on duty. (iii) They also spread awareness among the public to be careful and maintain peace. (iv) They prepare for any emergency and are ready to handle it. (v) All local police stations are always in contact with their head branch and cooperate with each other.
final_answer: Police work includes crowd management, emergency preparedness, and public awareness during events.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of police responsibilities during events.

subject: civics
question_text: Who is in charge of all the police stations in a district? Find out.
answer_text: The Superintendent of Police (SP) is in charge of all the police stations in a district, while the local police station is headed by the Station House Officer (SHO).
final_answer: The SP oversees all police stations in a district.
